title: Acceptance probability under independent repetition
statement: For a nonadaptive tester $T$ and a function $f$ from its query domain to its codomain, the acceptance probability of the tester formed by running $k$ independent copies of $T$ and accepting exactly when every copy accepts is the $k$th power of the acceptance probability of $T$ on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive function tester T with finite seed space and a seed probability law
A function f from the query domain to the codomain
A natural number k of repetitions
